product.title: RAW NUTRITION Thavage Pre-workout
product.body_html:
RAW Nutrition Thavage Pre-Workout

A high-stim performance pre-workout built and personally formulated by 5x Mr. Olympia Classic Physique champion Chris Bumstead — designed for serious lifters, physique athletes, and experienced trainers who want a comprehensive all-in-one formula combining explosive power, strength, focus, and energy in a single scoop. Particularly suited to those running heavy training programmes, lifters chasing real strength PRs, and anyone who's outgrown entry-level pre-workouts and wants athlete-led ingredient selection rather than mass-market formulations.

What separates Thavage from the typical pre-workout on the market comes down to ingredient synergy and athlete-driven formulation. The formula is built around a deliberate stack of trusted performance ingredients including L-Tyrosine for cognitive sharpness and focus, Beta Alanine for muscular endurance and lactic-acid buffering during high-rep work, Arginine Nitrate for nitric oxide production and enhanced blood flow, Huperzine A and Alpha-GPC for nootropic-grade mental focus and the mind-muscle connection, and Bitter Orange for thermogenic energy and amplified fat burning. The synergistic effect across these ingredients delivers improved cellular hydration, sharp mental focus, sustained energy production, optimised blood flow, and a thermogenic edge — all in a single scoop. Thavage was personally designed by Chris Bumstead through his own training cycles, which gives it a level of competition-proven credibility that mass-market pre-workouts simply don't carry. Important caveat: high-stimulant formula — start with a half-scoop (half-Thavage) to assess tolerance before scaling to a full-Thavage 2-scoop serving. Not for beginners or caffeine-sensitive users.

RAW Nutrition manufactures Thavage Pre-Workout in the United States in facilities certified to GMP standards, with rigorous quality control across the range. Note: this specific pre-workout is not Informed-Sport certified — competing tested-pool athletes should always check the most current ingredient panel against their governing body's banned-substance list before use; for everyone else, RAW's manufacturing pedigree, athlete-led product development, and full label transparency make it one of the more credible options at the high-stim end of the pre workout Sri Lanka category.

  • L-Tyrosine and Alpha-GPC focus stack — sharp cognitive output and mind-muscle connection during heavy training
  • Beta Alanine for muscular endurance — lactic-acid buffering effect that delays fatigue during high-rep work
  • Arginine Nitrate for blood flow and pumps — nitric oxide production for vasodilation and nutrient delivery
  • Huperzine A and Bitter Orange for energy and thermogenic support — sustained intensity with a fat-burning edge
  • Personally formulated by Chris Bumstead — strong value at the pre workout price in Sri Lanka category for those wanting athlete-proven formulation; useful answer to the pre workout or creatine which is better question (different purposes — most serious lifters use both)

Pair it with a quality whey protein from our protein and recovery range to round out a complete training stack — a pre-workout drives the session, a post-workout protein shake drives the recovery.
